headline: Salbiah starts gas production; Fatimah gets investment go-ahead
news: DIALOG announced on 11 November 2026 that the Salbiah gas field began commercial production on 27 October, following completion of development work. The company also confirmed a final investment decision for Fatimah, the second development under the Baram Junior Cluster contract offshore Sarawak, involving an additional US$211 million. Fatimah is to be developed; this announcement does not report its start-up.
engineering: Practical engineering question: as a gas development moves into operation, does the integrity plan explain which components are inspected and which risk assumptions still need verification? The selections alongside explore inspection coverage and offshore risk assessment. This is an editorial question, not a finding about either DIALOG project.

field.teaser: The Chevron Richmond fire illustrates why inspection coverage matters as much as inspection frequency. Individual components can deteriorate differently within the same piping circuit.

research.teaser: The authors present a quantitative risk assessment interface for fixed offshore oil and gas platforms.
